loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
class PromptAgent(Agent):
    """prompt-based agent that emits action given the history"""
loop_primitives.note: PromptAgent calls the LLM once per step to predict the next action from the trajectory (observe -> act loop). The inner `while True` loop re-queries only on ActionParsingError, up to gen_config max_retry; that is step-level format retry, not multi_attempt. The excerpt does not show the outer episode loop, and line numbers are not available in the excerpt. TeacherForcingAgent replays a fixed reference action sequence and is not a model loop.
